decision: minimum gate passed; formal256 recommended only as a frozen confirmatory run

interpretation.reason: All efficiency gates pass. Main-quality and geometry/force paired 95% intervals cross zero; RMSD and mean-force point estimates are 1.19x and 1.11x C0 rather than the approximately 2x V1 geometry failure. The elevated E-hull and force-tail point estimates remain the primary confirmatory risk.
interpretation.no_equivalence_claim: No equivalence margin was prespecified, so crossing zero is not proof of equivalence.
constraints_for_formal256: do not tune checkpoint, thresholds, schedule, or risk model
use new seeds disjoint from all V1/V2 train, validation, and test ranges
predeclare force-tail and E-hull stopping criteria
